text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you describe the specific movements you've been experiencing, such as tremors, stiffness, or involuntary jerking? How long have these symptoms been present?

speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old college student. The patient is here for a follow-up appointment. He was recently diagnosed with schizophrenia and started on risperidone approximately 2 months ago. Reports a significant improvement in psychiatric symptoms since the start of treatment.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is excellent news regarding your psychiatric improvement. However, since you started risperidone two months ago, I need to know: have you developed any new involuntary movements, muscle stiffness, or restlessness since beginning the medication?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Inability to remain still, persistent feeling of restlessness. I also have Frequent fidgeting, Repetitive crossing and uncrossing of legs, Pacing.

speaker: Doctor
text: These symptoms strongly suggest akathisia, a common side effect of antipsychotic medication. To confirm this and rule out other causes, I need to assess your current medication dosage and check for any other neurological signs. REQUEST TEST: Neurological_Exam
